example: Rooted grass around one fixed stone
qualification_status: Documented component chain; execute locally before Cyrus use
version_context: Houdini 22.0 for Guide Utility and current Guide Deform
node_operator_order: Guide Utility → rest/thickness/ID prep → Vellum Constraints Hair → Vellum Constraints Pin to Animation → Vellum Solver (stone/ground input 3) → Vellum Post-Process/diagnostics → Guide Deform or Point Deform → File Cache/Vellum I/O → TimeShift → Alembic/USD/bgeo
input_geometry_and_attributes: Ground mesh; root-first guide curves; roots group; rest; pscale; stable guide/piece ID; optional orient/restorient; dense curves or polygon grass in rest pose; collision-suitable stone
root_position: Vellum Pin Type Permanent for hard root; Soft for compliant attachment
root_orientation: Separate Orientation Pin Type: free, same as position, or soft with bend/twist stiffness
simulation_or_static: Automatic fitting is a timeline Vellum solve. Manual static alternative: Guide Groom Brush/Deintersect/Sculpt with Physics + Set Rest State.
collision_representation: Full Vellum polygon collider; pscale must include visible blade/card envelope; low/moderate friction; self-collision initially off
initialize_reset_change: Begin clear or animate collider from clear start; Reset Simulation after obstacle/source/settings changes; moving stone invalidates from start frame
freeze_cache: Vellum I/O or File Cache, Load from Disk, TimeShift accepted settled frame
render_export: Render cached dense curves/mesh; Alembic/USD/bgeo; export unique shape data when bends differ
sharing_instancing: Sparse preprocessing shared; affected guide and dense output state is per instance; unaffected plants can remain packed/instanced
major_artist_actions: ~10–12 with prepared guides; add ~4–10+ for root/guide/binding preparation on arbitrary meshes
common_failures_and_remedies: Root drift→Permanent pin; root hinge→soft orientation pin; external collision failures→fix initialization/thickness/segmentation/substeps; guide clear but mesh penetrates→include visible envelope and validate final mesh; Point Deform bleed→piece isolation/capture tuning
required_local_gate: H01: 20 clumps, controls outside influence, measure root/angular drift, length error, guide/final mesh penetration, reopen, render/export agreement
